TEXT:
[FI] Manami and I stopped by Adashino Nenbutsu-ji 
Temple. From there, we started our stroll towards 
Togetsu-kyo Bridge.

[FI] On the way, we ate the lunch that Manami made 
and then continued our walk.

[FI] We toured from Gio-ji Temple to Tenryu-ji Temple, 
by the time we finally arrived at Togetsu-kyo 
Bridge, the sun had already started its descent.

SPEAKER: SPK_MANAMI
TEXT: [FI] Look, Kyou-chan! It's Togetsu-kyo Bridge.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] At last, we've finally arrived.

SPEAKER: SPK_MANAMI
TEXT:
[FI] The temples were incredible, huh? It felt like we 
stepped back in time... I am really impressed.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT:
[FI] You're totally exaggerating. I get what you mean, 
though.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT:
[FI] Honestly, I'm not that interested in stuff like that. 
Even so, after seeing these historical sites, I can 
understand how compelling it might be to some.

SPEAKER: SPK_MANAMI
TEXT: [FI] Yep, yep!

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT:
[FI] Not only that, the scenery was fantastic too. Even 
though we were just strolling, I didn't feel bored at 
all.

[FI] I used to think that only the elderly went 
sightseeing like this... Guess I should change my 
mindset.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] This might be Manami's influence...

SPEAKER: SPK_MANAMI
TEXT: [FI] Eh? Did you say something?

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] No... I said your interests line up with the elderly.

SPEAKER: SPK_MANAMI
TEXT: [FI] Geez, you're so mean, Kyou-chan.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] Still, that was a fun experience.

SPEAKER: SPK_MANAMI
TEXT: [FI] I'm glad to hear that. It was fun for me, too.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT:
[FI] It was a surprising way to spend our leisure time. 
So, what now? Should we cross the Togetsu-kyo 
Bridge and make our way to Horin-ji Temple?

SPEAKER: SPK_MANAMI
TEXT:
[FI] Okay. I'm happy that you're bringing up 
suggestions.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] Well, that settles it...

[FI] It was then I suddenly realized that Manami's 
expression suggests that she's a little worn out.

[FI] Why didn't I realize this sooner? Get your act 
together, Kousaka Kyousuke!

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] Hey... Maybe we should take a break at the inn?

SPEAKER: SPK_MANAMI
TEXT: [FI] Eh? Aren't we heading to Horin-ji Temple?

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT:
[FI] Well, we've walked quite a distance today. There's 
no point in pushing ourselves too hard and ending 
up unable to walk tomorrow...

SPEAKER: SPK_MANAMI
TEXT: [FI] I'm not tired though, honest!

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT:
[FI] No, I'm the one that's tired already. In fact, I wasn't 
able to sleep at all last night.

SPEAKER: SPK_MANAMI
TEXT: [FI] Kyou-chan...

[FI] It might be that I'm bad at lying since it looks like 
she saw right through me.

SPEAKER: SPK_MANAMI
TEXT: [FI] ...Sorry, Kyou-chan.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT:
[FI] No worries. There are other things to enjoy on a 
trip than just sightseeing. Relaxing at the inn is one 
of many, right?

SPEAKER: SPK_MANAMI
TEXT: [FI] ...Thank you.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT:
[FI] Speaking of which, how do we get to the inn from 
here?

SPEAKER: SPK_MANAMI
TEXT: [FI] Hold on a moment, I'll check.

[FI] Manami pulls out her smartphone and clumsily 
starts sliding her fingers around.

[FI] ...Hang on. Wasn't she using those simple phones 
made before the smartphone boom?

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] So when did you get a new phone?

SPEAKER: SPK_MANAMI
TEXT: [FI] Ehehe... I tried following the current trends.

SPEAKER: SPK_MANAMI
TEXT: [FI] All my classmates have these.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT:
[FI] And here I thought since you're essentially a 
granny stuck in a young girl's body, you can't pick 
up new technology like the youngsters do...

SPEAKER: SPK_MANAMI
TEXT: [FI] Whaaa~?!

[FI] As we speak, I noticed she's having a hard time 
using her new phone.

[FI] I can't help but chuckle. She's just like a granny 
struggling with electronics.

SPEAKER: SPK_MANAMI
TEXT:
[FI] Ummm, there should be a map app on my home 
screen... huh?

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] Will that help us get to the inn?

SPEAKER: SPK_MANAMI
TEXT:
[FI] This smartphone has a GPS, it'll give us directions 
on where we want to go. Kirino and Ayase taught 
me that~

[FI] Peeking over from the side, she's been tapping all 
over the screen, but it doesn't look like she found 
the app yet.

SPEAKER: SPK_MANAMI
TEXT: [FI] Don't worry, leave it to me.

[FI] Keeping her head down, she works her smartphone 
in a panic.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] Do you really know how to use that thing?

SPEAKER: SPK_MANAMI
TEXT:
[FI] N... No problem! I even know how to send my own 
emails...

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] That's because I showed you how...

SPEAKER: SPK_MANAMI
TEXT:
[FI] Huh?! I should just email Kirino and ask her to 
teach me!

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT:
[FI] Aah, calm down, Manami. If you ask her trivial 
things like this, she'll just get annoyed.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] Let me see it. I'll do it.

SPEAKER: SPK_MANAMI
TEXT: [FI] Eh? You know how?

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] Mmm, maybe. Give it here.

SPEAKER: SPK_MANAMI
TEXT: [FI] Here you go, I'm counting on you.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] Okay, let's see here... Open this, go here...

SPEAKER: SPK_MANAMI
TEXT: [FI] Wow! Amazing!

[FI] All I did was open the app, but Manami looked at 
me with reverence.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] This should be fine, right?

SPEAKER: SPK_MANAMI
TEXT: [FI] Thank you.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT:
[FI] I'll teach you later, okay? Make sure you 
remember.

[FI] She's really smart, so why does she have such a 
hard time with electronics?

SPEAKER: SPK_MANAMI
TEXT:
[FI] Okay. If you're the one teaching, I probably won't 
forget.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] "Probably"...

SPEAKER: SPK_MANAMI
TEXT: [FI] Hehe~

[FI] While I try to suppress my anxiety about her 
future, I follow the map on her phone and head for 
our inn.
